channel.title: Kinexus Insights
channel.description: Straight talk for factory owners: buyer audits, quality proof, data integrity, and cash discipline.

item.title: The buyer's first question isn't price anymore. It's proof.
item.description: Serious apparel buyers now open with compliance and traceability, then move to price. Proof compounds — price gets you compared, proof gets you kept.

item.title: Your next audit will be won or lost in your records, not your lab
item.description: Most failed pharma inspections aren't about bad medicine — they're about bad records of good medicine. Close the gap at the source, permanently.
